question: How many days of annual leave do I get each year?
reference_answer: Every full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1]

question: Can I carry over unused vacation days?
reference_answer: Up to 5 unused days can be carried forward and must be used by 31 March. [1]

question: Do I need a doctor's note if I am ill for three days?
reference_answer: A medical certificate is required when sick leave lasts more than 2 consecutive days. [1]

question: How much notice do I need to give for a 7-day leave?
reference_answer: Longer requests need 5 working days of notice. [1]

question: How long is maternity leave?
reference_answer: Maternity leave is 26 weeks of paid leave. [1]

question: How many days off do I get when a family member dies?
reference_answer: Employees may take 5 days of paid bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member. [1]

question: How many days a week must I be in the office?
reference_answer: Employees work from the office 3 days a week. [1]

question: Can I work from another country?
reference_answer: Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 days per year with written approval from HR and IT security. [1]

question: What are the core working hours?
reference_answer: Core working hours are 10:00 to 16:00 local time. [1]

question: Is there money for setting up my home office?
reference_answer: A one-time home-office stipend of $300 is paid. [1]

question: Within how many days must I submit an expense claim?
reference_answer: Submit expense claims within 30 days of the expense. [1]

question: What is the daily meal limit for an international trip?
reference_answer: Meals are reimbursed up to $75 per day for international travel. [1]

question: Who approves an expense claim of $2,000?
reference_answer: Claims above $500 need director approval. [1]

question: How long until my approved claim is paid?
reference_answer: Approved claims are paid within 10 working days. [1]

question: How many characters must my password have?
reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. [1]

question: What should I do if my laptop is stolen?
reference_answer: Report a lost or stolen laptop to security@acme.example within 1 hour. [1]

question: Can I save work files on a USB stick?
reference_answer: Company data must not be stored on personal cloud storage or USB drives. [1]

question: When do I need to use the VPN?
reference_answer: Use the company VPN when connected to public Wi-Fi. [1]

question: How far in advance should I book a flight?
reference_answer: Book travel at least 14 days before departure. [1]

question: What is the hotel price limit per night abroad?
reference_answer: Hotel cost is capped at $250 per night for international trips. [1]

question: Can I fly business class?
reference_answer: Business class is allowed only for flights over 8 hours and needs VP approval. [1]

question: How do I report harassment anonymously?
reference_answer: Report concerns to the anonymous Ethics Hotline. [1]

question: What is the maximum value of a gift I can accept from a vendor?
reference_answer: Do not accept gifts worth more than $50 from vendors or clients. [1]

question: How many public holidays does the company give?
reference_answer: Acme gives 10 paid company holidays per year. [1]

question: Is the office closed at the end of the year?
reference_answer: The office is closed from 26 December to 31 December. [1]
